question: What lack of devotion disqualifies a person in this teaching?
premises: A person may be devoid of devotion to the Kula.
A person may be deprived of devotion to the guru.
inference: Lack of devotion to both the Kula and the guru marks an unqualified person.
plain_english: In one who is devoid of devotion to the Kula and deprived of devotion to the guru.
